<title level="1" right="Condition">[Unnoticed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=98)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 447

If you're unnoticed by a creature, that creature has no idea you're present. When you're unnoticed, you're also [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39). This matters for abilities that can be used only against targets totally unaware of your presence.
name: Unnoticed
